## Features

- Automatic proxy configuration from .env
- Auto-mount HuggingFace cache directory
- No host dependencies (Python, pip, huggingface-hub)
- Uses same container image as vLLM services
- Supports batch and individual model downloads
- Resume download capability

## Model Configuration (INT4 Quantization)

All 6 models configured with AWQ/GPTQ INT4 quantization:
- chat-light: Eslzzyl/Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507-AWQ (2.5GB)
- chat-fast: JunHowie/Qwen3-8B-GPTQ-Int4 (2.5GB)
- chat-advanced: Qwen/Qwen3-32B-AWQ (9GB)
- code-traditional: Qwen/Qwen2.5-Coder-32B-Instruct-AWQ (9GB)
- code-agentic: Qwen/Qwen3-30B-A3B-GPTQ-Int4 (8GB)
- vision: Qwen/Qwen2-VL-7B-Instruct-GPTQ-Int4 (2.5GB)

Total memory reduction: ~272GB → ~65GB (76% reduction)

## Usage

# Download all quantized models
./download-quantized-models.sh

# Download specific model
./download-quantized-models.sh --model chat-light
